## Dapp listing submission

Please complete this checklist:

- [ ] I have permission to submit this metadata and agree that the manifest will be shared under the registry data license.
- [ ] The website and social links are official project links.
- [ ] Every contract or program address belongs to this project and is deployed on the selected chain.
- [ ] I selected the closest primary category and added no more than three tags.
- [ ] I have not included secrets, private keys, API keys, or RPC URLs.
- [ ] I understand that a merged manifest is reviewed registry data; publication on DappSignal follows maintainer verification and registry sync.
